warhead.provenance: Annular blast-fragmentation warhead, 90 lb = 40.8 kg per OOB (csg-us-essm-navy, A). Lethal radius/damage/case-explosive split are engineering-estimate surrogates following the aim_120c.json pattern.

fuze.provenance: No public fuze timing data; engineering-estimate scaffold values consistent with a point-defense semi-active-radar SAM.

_real_world.role: Point/short-range air-defense SAM, quad-packed 4/cell in Mk 41 (Mk 25) or 8 per Mk 29 launcher
_real_world.range_nmi: n/p (Navy: Classified); ~27 nmi (50 km) open source (C-est)
_real_world.guidance_real: Semi-active CW/ICW illumination with S/X-band midcourse uplink (Block 1)
_real_world.mount_mapping: vls_sam (quad-packed cells) or ciws-style Mk 29 launcher per ship; documented per-ship in the ship record

guidance.type.note: OOB: semi-active CW/ICW illumination (Block 1). Engine's guidance.type loader only recognizes ActiveRadar/Radar or IR/Infrared as seeker_type; semi-active radar has no dedicated engine category, so ActiveRadar is used as the nearest available bucket. Engine mechanism gap, not a modeling choice

max_flight_time_s.note: engineering estimate derived from the ~27 nmi open-source range at the Mach 4+ proxy speed; Navy classifies both figures

flight_model.max_speed.note: Navy classifies speed; open-source Mach 4+ used as estimate, ~1361.7 m/s at sea level

flight_model.max_g.note: no public figure; engineering estimate reflecting ESSM's known high-agility point-defense role (thrust-vectored variants), higher than SM-2/SM-6

flight_model.max_turn_rate.note: no public figure; engineering estimate consistent with max_g for a thrust-vectored point-defense SAM, higher than SM-2/SM-6

guidance.active_seek_range.note: 0.0: ESSM's real terminal mode is semi-active (requires ship illumination), not a true active seeker with its own acquisition range; set to 0 to avoid implying a self-contained active seeker capability it doesn't have

guidance.pn_los_rate_source.note: standard engine guidance-model wiring default, not a sourced weapon characteristic; VLS/Mk 29 mount override makes this documentation-only for launched use

guidance.target_kinematics_estimator.note: standard engine guidance-model wiring default, same basis as pn_los_rate_source

guidance.capture_guidance_mode.note: disabled: no terminal capture-guidance submode is modeled beyond the semi-active homing already described

guidance.target_tracker_alpha.note: standard alpha-beta-gamma tracker filter constant, engine convention shared across missile records, not weapon-specific

guidance.target_tracker_beta.note: standard tracker filter constant, same basis as target_tracker_alpha

guidance.target_tracker_gamma.note: standard tracker filter constant, same basis as target_tracker_alpha

guidance.nav_gain.note: proportional-navigation gain scaffold; highest among the packet's SAMs, consistent with ESSM's thrust-vectored point-defense terminal homing against highly maneuverable threats

guidance.apn_target_accel_gain.note: augmented-PN target-acceleration compensation gain scaffold, consistent with intercepting a maneuvering anti-ship missile; not sourced per-weapon

guidance.autopilot_tau_s.note: autopilot response time-constant scaffold; fastest among the packet's SAMs, consistent with ESSM's thrust-vectored high-agility design

guidance.max_accel_response_g_per_s.note: autopilot response-rate scaffold, highest among the packet's SAMs consistent with flight_model.max_g
